metadata.rust_flags: Cargo release defaults; no target-cpu override; runtime Pulp dispatch
metadata.method: same deterministic fixtures; fresh processes; alternating baseline/candidate or candidate/DUCC; reusable plans/workspaces; target 25 ms; 10 calibrated batches under 100 ms/call and 5 individual calls otherwise
metadata.cases: f32 GL spin-1 STANDARD, full mmax, even-smooth nphi, T255 (ntheta=256,nphi=512) and T720 (ntheta=721,nphi=1470), phi0=0.23; analysis/synthesis; q1/q8
metadata.cold_warm: Separate setup/first/warm q8 data at T255/T720 is in cold-warm.csv. CPU PSI snapshots are omitted from sanitized data.
